[spoiler=[b]Sabrati Civil War|Twin Corridors Operations[/b]] Recap*
After the fall of the Neo-Human Fascist Party in 1946, and the establishment of the Oceanice Republic, led to the reformations of a centralized government into a republic that adopted a Hyper-Capitalist and Democratic Militarism Doctrine. Both the new government of Oceanice Republic and ULR tension increased in the early 1947 to 1948, during the standoff between Argos Straight and the dominance of the sea. What led to the first development of the Cold War in 1949, with tension peaking over power influence and trade. The first proxy war began with the Oceanice Republic's goal to support the Democratic Coalition, aiming to replace authoritarian or monarchist factions with a government aligned with Oceanics democratic-militarist doctrine.

Twin Corridors Operations

Both the Oceanice Republic & Mizrahel Support for the Democratic Coalition offer support in the civil war by the Port of Mizrahel at 03:12 Hours. A thick dust rolled off the water as the great floodlights of the Mizrahel Naval Command Pier blinked to life. The first container ship, the O.N.S. Varensh, eased alongside the reinforced dock, its hull marked only with a small Oceanice Republic code ORSAB1953/42.
Mizrahel dockworkers armed, disciplined, and moving, in a rush as the ramp lowered.

The crates began to appear. With Panzer IVs and Panthers, their turrets covered in canvas.  Two Tiger I chassis, freshly restored by Oceanice engineers.  Rows of M41 Walker Bulldogs secured with steel chains. Pallets of StG 44s, MP40s, Kar98ks, and MG42s carefully marked for the Democratic Coalition.

Commander Ravell Arsen, Mizrahel Defense Force liaison, turned to the Oceanice officer beside him
.
Commander Ravell (Mizrahel)
"Your people rebuilt half of these tanks from scrap. They look new."

Captain Veylan Strass (Oceanice Republic)
We dont give allies leftovers. We give them tools to win.

Captain Strass handed over the manifest. It was heavy.

Split Supply Operation | Twin Corridors
Route 1 | Northern Corridor, Land Border
From Mizrahels northern frontier into Democratic Coalition territory.Includes following
Halftracks of Sd.Kfz. 250 & 251, Panzer 35t and 38t light tanks, CCKW trucks
Ambulances Dodge WC-54, Mauser rifles, MGs, and Panzerfausts. Along side was fill with artillery of Nebelwerfer 42, 10.5 cm leFH, 15 cm sFH 18

Route 2 | Southern Coastal Corridor
Fast-moving naval convoys from Oceanice → Mizrahel → Democratic Coalition port cities. Includes Me 262 and Bf 109 airframes, Fw 190 and Boomerang CAS aircraft, Hummel SPGs, Wirbelwinds & Flakpanzer 38t, 8.8 cm Flak batteries, LVT-4 and LVTP-5 amphibious landing vehicles

Democratic Coalition Training Camp

Northern Sabrata Border |19:47 Hours

The desert night and the hum of engines filled the air as the Democratic Coalition recruits gathered around a new sight, with Mizraheli MSF special forces advisors and Oceanice general who used to serve back in the Post Neo-Human Regime.  Newly delivered of regime-era and early-modern armor. Captain Strass stood before a freshly assembled unit of Democratic Coalition fighters, their uniforms mismatched, but their eyes focused. Behind him, an MG42 barked into the dunes as Oceanice instructors demonstrated fire discipline.

Captain Strass (Oceanice)
You are not rebels anymore.
 You are a fighting force.
 And you will break the monarchists' rule for once!
He motioned toward a row of covered vehicles.
(Tarps lifted, revealing a Tiger II, in a desert camouflaged armor, gleaming under the lanterns. Two Panther Ausf. G units freshly painted while seven Sd.Kfz. 251s equipped for troop transport. A Nebelwerfer 42 ready for testing firing, and a line of StG 44s laid neatly on wooden tables

A Coalition officer, General Issam Daruk, stepped forward.

General Issam
This is enough to change the front.

Captain Strass:
No.
 This is enough to start changing it.
A whistle blew in the distance. The first Me 262, newly refitted and painted with Democratic Coalition markings, roared overhead on a test flight.
The Coalition fighters stared in awe.

Mizrahel Special Forces enter the scene. Mizrahel special operators emerged from the black balaclavas, suppressed rifles.

MSF Team Leader
 Dagon
We handle your raids.
 Your reconnaissance.
 Your targeting for artillery.
He pointed toward a distant Royalist outpost.
We will teach you how to strike silently.
 Oceanice will supply the firepower to strike.

Captain Strass stepped forward again, gripping Issams shoulder*

Captain Strass
The ULR and their royalists believe you are outnumbered, outgunned
 But what they dont know
 is that you now have us.

He nodded once, sharply.

Tomorrow, we begin the combined training of
 Tanks.
 Anti-air.
 Urban combat.
 Air-ground coordination.
 Night assaults with MSF support.

He looked across the desert moonlight

Captain Strass
By the end of the month, Democratic Coalition, you will not just resist. You will advance.
 And when you advance! Oceanice Republic and her allies will ensure you gain your freedom!

The recruits cheered, their voices. With Mizrahels border open, Oceanices convoys flowing, and MSF instructors on the ground, the Democratic Coalition had a focus on making them become well trained army.[/spoiler]
